projects.title: Work and Solve Online Judge
projects.description: Through the development of Work and Solve Online Judge, I've aimed to modernize competitive programming and job marketplaces. This platform offers a diverse range of algorithmic programming tasks, an intuitive job marketplace, and flexible APIs for custom applications. Submitted codes are securely tested in isolated enviroments by efficient testing system. Additionally, it provides comprehensive learning resources including detailed editorials and solutions for problems. Recognized for its innovation, the project claimed the top 1 spot in the 'Web-applications' category at the Yandex Lyceum project competition.
